title: MCP & Tools
description: Which integrations the agents actually call, and which teams call them. Server names are normalised: the same MCP arrives under several names depending on the transport.

list.name: contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1
list.label: Contributor

list.name: team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos r LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = r.contributor LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id ORDER BY 1
list.label: Team

panels.title: MCP share
panels.description: How much of the agents' work goes through an MCP server rather than a built-in tool like Bash or Edit. A low number is not a failure: most work is editing files. It says how much the agents depend on integrations someone has to keep running.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(e.mcp_server IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 1) AS v
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.title: Which MCP servers are used
panels.description: Calls per server, with transport aliases folded together — the same server arrives named five different ways depending on which agent invoked it, and unnormalised the busiest one looks like five minor ones. This answers whether an integration someone is paying for is actually being called.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) AS `server`, COUNT(*) AS `calls`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.mcp_server IS NOT NULL AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server','')))
ORDER BY `calls` DESC

panels.title: Share of MCP calls
panels.description: The same servers as parts of a whole, so one integration dominating is visible at a glance. Volume, not value: a server called constantly by one automated workflow will outrank one a person reaches for deliberately.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) AS `server`, COUNT(*) AS `calls`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.mcp_server IS NOT NULL AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server','')))
ORDER BY `calls` DESC

panels.title: Which MCP each team uses
panels.description: Server calls per team. Teams standardising on different integrations is the point of this panel: a licence renewal is a different conversation when one team accounts for all the use, and an integration nobody calls is a cost with no reader.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') AS `team`,
       SUM(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) = 'playwright') AS `playwright`,
       SUM(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) = 'jira')       AS `jira`,
       SUM(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) = 'linear')     AS `linear`,
       SUM(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) = 'figma')      AS `figma`,
       SUM(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) = 'github')     AS `github`,
       SUM(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) = 'sentry')     AS `sentry`,
       SUM(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) = 'notion')     AS `notion`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.mcp_server IS NOT NULL AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)')
ORDER BY `team`

panels.title: Tools called most, within MCP
panels.description: The individual tool behind each call, not just the server. This is the granularity that answers whether an integration is used for the thing it was bought for — a Jira MCP called only to read issues is a different purchase from one used to file and transition them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.tool, '__', -1), '_', ' ') AS `tool`,
       COUNT(*) AS `calls`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.tool LIKE 'mcp\\_\\_%' AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.tool, '__', -1), '_', ' ')
ORDER BY `calls` DESC
LIMIT 12

panels.title: MCP use over time
panels.description: Calls per server per day. A server appearing partway through is an integration being adopted; one falling to zero is either a workflow that ended or an integration that broke, and the two are worth telling apart.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(e.observed_at / 1000000000 / 86400) * 86400) AS `time`,
       LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) AS `metric`,
       COUNT(*) AS `value`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.mcp_server IS NOT NULL AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(e.observed_at / 1000000000 / 86400) * 86400), LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server','')))
ORDER BY `time`

panels.title: Built-in tools, for comparison
panels.description: The tools agents reach for without an integration. Shown beside the MCP panels because the ratio is the useful part: MCP calls are a small share of a much larger volume of ordinary editing, and a dashboard showing only MCP would imply otherwise.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.tool AS `tool`, COUNT(*) AS `calls`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.tool NOT LIKE 'mcp\\_\\_%' AND e.tool <> '' AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY e.tool
ORDER BY `calls` DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Sessions reaching for an integration
panels.description: How many sessions used any MCP at all, against those that used none. A session is one working stretch, so this reads as how often integrations enter the work rather than how many calls they generate — one automated loop can produce hundreds of calls in a single session.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.mcp_calls > 0 THEN 'used an MCP' ELSE 'built-ins only' END AS `kind`,
       COUNT(*) AS `sessions`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.mcp_calls > 0 THEN 'used an MCP' ELSE 'built-ins only' END
